name: ThreeJS Loader GLTF
description:
ThreeJS Loader GLTF displays the battle-scarred Damaged Helmet — a benchmark physically based model — lit and reflected by a real-world HDR sky.

How it works. The GLTFLoader reads a glTF 2.0 model together with its binary geometry buffer and a full physically based texture set — base colour, normal, metal-roughness, ambient occlusion and emissive maps — so the metal, glass and scorched paint each respond to light correctly. An…
